commentaries.author: parimēlaḻagar
commentaries.text:
Her friend tells her she can’t go on thinking of him without a break, and should forget him a little. She answers.

You in your bright jewels, if I forget him today, the day I am dying, then in my next birth too beauty will leave me and the bangles will slip from my arms. “Bright jewels” hints that you care nothing for this. If I think of him at this last moment I can reach him in the next life and be happy, so I mustn’t forget him.

மேல் can mean “on” or “hereafter”. He takes it as hereafter: she is dying today, and forgetting him now would cost her in her next birth.
